name: Tunnel
tagline: Simulates a target market with hundreds of AI agents you can interview, in seconds instead of months.
problem: Founders build products nobody wants; traditional market research is slow and expensive, the team argues.
solution: Generates hundreds of persona agents for a target market, simulates their reactions, visualizes the network, and lets founders talk to agents by voice.
demo_moment: Team-described: describe your product and call a simulated customer.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “VAPI: Best Voice AI Application” and “MLH: Best Use of Auth0” among 261 submissions.
Lets founders speak to simulated customers by voice.

lessons: Voice turns a simulation into a conversation judges can join.
